sources.title: BenhamdaneNawfal/sentiment-analysis-darija · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository hosts a Sentiment Analysis model for Darija (Moroccan Arabic dialect), built using BERT. The model is fine-tuned to classify text into two categories: positive and negative sentiment. It is designed to facilitate sentiment analysis in applications involving Darija text data, such as social media analysis, customer feedback, or market research.

sources.title: SI2M-Lab/DarijaBERT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DarijaBERT is the first BERT model for the Moroccan Arabic dialect called “Darija”. It is based on the same architecture as BERT-base, but without the Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) objective. This model was trained on a total of ~3 Million sequences of Darija dialect representing 691MB of text or a total of ~100M tokens.
